description:
Submit a strategy through the full verification pipeline: backtest -> dry run (7 days) -> verify -> publish. Returns the estimated publish date and the backtest gate the strategy will face (next to the house rule for its timeframe). Poll get_verification_status for the result, which carries reason_codes, constraints and condition_stats when the backtest falls short.

Platform fee: TradeAssi keeps 15% of every sale; you receive 85%, paid in USDC on Base (min $10). Nothing is listed until the forward test passes. Call get_marketplace_terms for details.

strategy_id.description: Strategy ID to submit for verification
